newsitem.title: PERU: Peru '96 int'l reserves rise 29.6 pct to $8.54 bln.
newsitem.headline: Peru '96 int'l reserves rise 29.6 pct to $8.54 bln.

text.p: Peru's Central Reserve Bank said Sunday its net international reserves rose 29.6 percent in 1996 to $8.540 billion from $6.641 billion at the end of 1995.
The bank's foreign exchange position, or total liquidity minus short and long-term debt obligations, was $1.717 billion at the end of 1996, the bank added in a report.
President Alberto Fujimori said earlier last month the government expected Peru's international reserves to rise above $10 billion by mid-1998.
